description: This file defines the Vacancy entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment system, mapped with Doctrine ORM. It includes properties such as id, job title, hiring manager, name, description, number of positions, status, publication status, defined time, and updated time, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Vacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a job vacancy within the recruitment plugin of OrangeHRM, including ORM mappings and business properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the vacancy.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the vacancy.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the associated JobTitle entity.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle entity with the vacancy.

methods.name: getHiringManager
methods.description: Returns the hiring manager Employee entity, if any.

methods.name: setHiringManager
methods.description: Sets the hiring manager Employee entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name/title of the vacancy.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name/title of the vacancy.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the vacancy, if any.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the vacancy.

methods.name: getNumOfPositions
methods.description: Returns the number of positions available.

methods.name: setNumOfPositions
methods.description: Sets the number of positions available.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the active/inactive status of the vacancy.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the active/inactive status of the vacancy.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Returns whether the vacancy is published in the feed.

methods.name: setIsPublished
methods.description: Sets the published status of the vacancy.

methods.name: getDefinedTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the vacancy was defined.

methods.name: setDefinedTime
methods.description: Sets the time when the vacancy was defined.

methods.name: getUpdatedTime
methods.description: Returns the last updated time of the vacancy.

methods.name: setUpdatedTime
methods.description: Sets the last updated time of the vacancy.
